description: Manage Business Central customers and vendors, and read companies, items and sales documents.

microsoft_dynamics_365_business_central_.description: Runs for each new customer in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, displayName, number, lastModifiedDateTime

microsoft_dynamics_365_business_central_.description: Runs for each new item in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
